senses.gloss: भुज- + आपीड भुज- + आपीड, m. clasping or enfolding in the arms.
भू-जम्बू भू-जम्बू, f. 1. wheat. 2. the fruit of the Flacourtia sapida.

1. भुज् भुज्, i. 6, Par.
 1. To bend, to make crooked.
 2. Pass. To incline one's self, Hit. iv. d. 28.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भुग्न,
 1. Bent, crooked.
 2. Bending, stooping.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अव अव, अवभुग्न, Crooked, MBh. 1, 5801.
 --Cf. Goth. biugan; A.S. bigan, búgan; O.H.G. baug; A.S. beág, beagrian; O.H.G. bogo; A.S. bóga; O.H.G. elin-bogo; A.S. elnboga, elboga; O.H.G. buoc, bûh; ϕεύγειν, ϕυγή; Lat. fugio, fuga; cf. A.S. bi-bugan, To flee away.

2. भुज् (akin to the preceding; cf. भज् and भञ्ज्), ii. 7, भुनज्, भुञ्ज्, Par. Ātm.
 1. To eat and drink, Man. 2, 53; Nal. 13, 68; Rām. 3, 53, 7.
 2. To enjoy (regularly, Ātm.), MBh. 3, 2167.
 3. To endure, Megh. 1.
 4. To govern, to possess (regularly, Par.), Man. 7, 148 (Ātm.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. भुक्त,
 1. Eaten.
 2. Possessed, Pañc. iii. d. 93.
 3. Eating, having eaten, Pañc. iv. d. 75; n. Food.
 --Comp.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 I. भोग्य, To be enjoyed, Pañc. i. d. 133. n.
 1. Enjoyment, Śāk. d. 47.
 2. Wealth.
 3. Grain. f. या, A whore.
 --Comp.
 अ-,
 I. adj. what cannot be enjoyed.
 II. n. absence of [] enjoyment, Megh. 111.
 सु-, adj. to be enjoyed easily, Pañc. iv. d. 84.
 II. भोज्य, To be eaten, edible. n.
 1. Food, meal, Hit. 76, 7, M.M.; milky messes, Man. 3, 227 (Kull.).
 2. Gratification, Man. 9, 268.
 --Comp.
 अ-, adj.
 1. prohibited as food, Pañc. 121, 16. 2. a person whose food must not be eaten, Man. 4, 221.
 कु-, n. bad food, Cāṇ. 30 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 409. Desider. बुभुक्ष,
 1. To wish to eat, MBh. 1, 8087.
 2. To wish to govern, or to possess, 1, 5667.
 --Caus.
 I. भोजय, To cause to eat, to invite, to give food, Man. 3, 106; 151; 8, 392; to treat, to entertain, Pañc. 26, 20.
 II. भुञ्जापय, To cause to eat, Lass. 12, 4.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To dispose of, Hit. 130, 4.
 --With अनु अनु, To receive the reward of, Man. 4, 240; Pañc. 259, 15.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To eat, to drink, Rām. 2, 30, 16; Ragh. 1, 68 (67).
 2. To enjoy, Hit. i. d. 112, M.M.
 3. To have a reward of, Man. 12, 8.
 4. To appropriate, 4, 202.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass.
 I. उपभोग्य, To be enjoyed, what may be eaten, Pañc. 86, 23. n. An object of enjoyment, MBh. 1, 2346.
 II. उपभोज्य, Edible, serving for food, MBh. 14, 2552.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To eat, Mṛcch. 297, 12 (Calc.).
 2. To enjoy, Kir. 5, 5.
 --With प्र प्र, To govern, Chr. 287, 5 = Rigv. i. 48, 5.
 --With सम् सम्, To enjoy, Hit. ii. d. 167; Rājat. 5, 283. अ-संभोज्य, m. One with whom nobody is allowed to eat, Man. 9, 238.
 --Caus. भोजय, To cause to eat, to treat, MBh. 3, 12672.
 --Cf. Lat. fungi; Goth. bugjan; A.S. bycgan, to buy (originally, to possess one's self of something); Goth. biuhts, biuhti. As भ्रञ्ज् for भञ्ज्, the original form was probably भ्रुञ्ज्, cf. Lat. frux, frugis, fruor, fructus, frustum, frustra, [] frutex; Goth. bruks, brûkjan; O.H.G. brûhan; A.S. brúcan, bryce.

3. ऽभुज् 2. -भुज्, latter part of comp. nouns.
 1. Eating, e. g. शेष-, adj. Eating the rest, Man. 3, 117.
 2. Enjoying, governing; e. g. क्षिति-, m. A king, Bhartṛ. 3, 78. क्षिति-लव-, m. A small prince, Bhartṛ. 3, 100. क्ष्मा-, गो-, जगती-, m. A king, Rājat. 5, 50; 6; 2, 44. देह-, m. Epithet of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1067. धरा-, पृथिवी-, m. A king, Rājat. 2, 7. बलि-, m. A crow. भू-, भूमी̆-, मही-, m. A king, Bhartṛ. 2, 47; Śṛṅgārat. 5; Rājat. 5, 11.

भुज 1. भुज् + अ, m., and f. जा.
 1. The arm, Pañc. 215, 7.
 2. The hand, Hiḍ. 1, 2.
 3. The proboscis of an elephant, Draup. 8, 21.
 4. A bending.
 --Comp.
भुजग 1. भुज् + अ-ग, m. A snake, Kir. 5, 4. f. गी, A female snake, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1156.

भुजंग भुजंग, 1. भुज् + अ + म्-ग,
 I. m.
 1. A snake, Bhartṛ. 2, 4; Vikr. 25, 20.
 2. A catamite, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 10.
 II. f. गी, A female snake.
भुजंगम भुजंगम, i. e. 1. भुज् + अ + म्-गम् + अ, m. A snake, Pañc. 174, 11; Bhartṛ. 2, 87.
भुजाकण्ट भुजा-कण्ट (cf. कण्टक), m. A finger-nail.
भुजान्तर भुजान्तर, i. e. भुज-अन्तर, n. The breast, Vikr. d. 112 (अल्प-, adj., f. रा, Having a small chest).

भुजिष्य भुज् + इष्य,
 I. m., and f. या, A servant, Nal. 13, 55.
 II. m.
 1. An independent man.
 2. A string worn round the wrist.
 III. f. या, A harlot.

भुज्यु 2. भुज् + यु, m.
 1. Eating.
 2. A vessel(?).
 3. A proper name, Chr. 296, 6 = Rigv. i. 112, 6.
भुजंग- + भोजिन् भुजंग- + भोजिन्, m. the boa constrictor.
भुज- + मध्य भुज- + मध्य, n. the breast, Ragh. 13, 73. []
भुजग- + राज भुजग- + राज, m. the king of the snakes, epithet of Śeṣa.
भुज- + शिरस् भुज- + शिरस्, n. the shoulder.
भुज- + संश्रय भुज- + संश्रय, m. taking refuge to one's arms, help of arms, Lass. 2. ed. 68. 33.
